home.greeting: Who do you want to meet tonight?
home.placeholder: Say it in your own words — who you'd like to meet, or what you'd love to do with someone…
home.placeholder_locked: Set up your profile first — the Agent needs to know you before it can introduce anyone.
home.agents_footnote: Two agents working in the background
home.chip_prompt_matchmaker: I'd like to meet someone new.
home.chip_prompt_sidebyside: I'd like to explore some interesting activities.
home.reception_title: Maitri is helping you figure out what you want
home.reception_error: Couldn't reach the conversation service. Please try again.
home.reception_clarify: Hey — I'm Maitri. I can chat with you, and when you're ready, help you meet someone new or find company for something. No rush — start wherever you like.
home.transition_matchmaker: Sure — tell me what kind of person you're hoping to meet.
home.transition_side: Sure — let's figure out what you'd like to do with someone.
home.wishes_sub: Activities you've posted to the pool

gate.title: The Agents need to know you first.
gate.body: Maitri shows people the words you write — not labels we infer. Take five minutes to set up your profile, then come back.

banner.waiting_title: Still holding a wish for you
banner.waiting_hint: I'll keep looking while you're away.

history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing yet. Start a wish from the home page and it'll show up here.

matchmaker.name: Meet someone
matchmaker.desc: Tell the agent what kind of person makes a room feel different for you. It introduces one person at a time, with a reason.

sidebyside.name: Do something together
sidebyside.tagline: Meet over something you both already do.
sidebyside.desc: Tell the agent what you do — tennis, runs, climbing, a bookstore Saturday. Once a week, it proposes one real meet. Both have to say yes; either says no and the other never knows.

chat.placeholder_first: Tell me about who you're looking for…
chat.placeholder_followup: Reply, or tell me what to change
chat.disclaimer: Mock profiles. Nothing leaves your browser.

persona.ai_card_note: An AI companion based on this profile card — for practicing hellos and chat. Not a real user.
persona.connected_note: You can keep chatting with this AI persona.

intro.empty_hint: Not a list — one person at a time, with a reason. Tell me what you're looking for on the left.
intro.faded_note: This one didn't land. It happens — I won't recommend them again.
intro.ask_name_prompt: Before I introduce you — what should they call you? Just your first name is fine.
intro.ask_city_prompt: One more thing — which city are you in? I mention it so hellos don't feel out-of-nowhere.

moment.pick_one: Pick the one that landed for you
moment.reply_placeholder: Not a compliment, not a question — what you thought when you read this, or your own version of it.
moment.reply_hint: They'll see only this and the one you picked. Not your name yet, not your photo. If they don't reply, they never know you saw them.
moment.need_user_moments: Heads up: your profile is thin. If they say hello back, they won't have anything of yours to read. Edit your profile to add a Moment or two.
moment.anchor_label: What you've already seen of each other
moment.compose_hint: Which one do you want to reply to? Tap one — optional.
moment.reply_placeholder_open: The first thing you want to say to them…

connection.title: Connections
connection.save_hint: Keep them for later. Find them back under Saved in the top bar.
connection.save_hint_saved: Kept. Find them under Saved in the top bar.
connection.hello_hint: They'll see what you wrote and the part of theirs you read. Not your name yet — that only unlocks if they reply.
connection.empty: No one yet. Say hello to someone here and they'll show up in Connections.
connection.pick_one: Pick a conversation on the left.
connection.waiting_hint: As soon as they write back, this fills in. You can keep meeting others in the meantime.
connection.withdraw_hint: Removes it from your side. They won't be notified.
connection.delete_chat_body: It will be removed from your connections. They won't be notified — you may still see each other in matching.
connection.faded_body: This one didn't land. That's fine — the door isn't locked. You can write something new, or clear the record.

wishes.title: My wishes
wishes.empty: No wishes published yet. Once you post, we'll keep looking for a match.

incoming.label: Someone read you
incoming.pick_to_reply: Pick one of {{name}}'s moments to reply to — optional
incoming.hint: If you don't feel it, just close this. They won't be told.

gate.title: Let them see you, not keywords.
gate.body: What others read is written in your own words. Fill in a little or a lot — it saves as you type.
gate.return_hint: Changes save as you type — hit the back arrow whenever you're ready.

hello.faded_hint: This didn't land last time. It's OK to move on — or say something new.

meet.opening: What do you want to do this week — and want company for? Just say it in your own words. If someone in the pool is waiting on the same thing, I'll match you two.
meet.truncated_hint: That's a lot — I only pulled keywords from the first part.
meet.fallback_intro: I only know people around a few things. Pick one and I'll keep going.

intent.match_label: Both sides published — this is the match
intent.match_label_close: Close match — not exact, but worth a look
intent.close_reason_when: Different time — but the activity and level line up.
intent.close_reason_level: Different level — but the activity and time line up.
intent.published_card_hint: This is how others see your wish in the pool.
intent.near_label: Same thing, different time or level
intent.near_hint: Nobody exactly on your slot right now. These people already put down a wish that overlaps — tap one to shift your published wish to match.
intent.aligned_body: Both of you want to do {{kind}} · {{when}} · {{level}}.
intent.why_person_moment_lead: No direct overlap with what you told the Agent — read TA's own words first.
intent.tell_agent_empty: The Agent hasn't heard you describe the kind of person you want to meet yet.
intent.tell_agent_placeholder: One line is enough — what kind of person?
intent.tell_agent_thanks: Got it — the Agent will use that from now on.
intent.chat_empty_hint: Say hello. Their wish card is attached above — they can tap it for details.
intent.left_placeholder_during_chat: Ask the Agent something, or publish a new wish…
intent.narrate_matched: Published '{{summary}}'. Someone in the pool wants the same thing — see the right side.
intent.narrate_nomatch: Published '{{summary}}'. Nobody in the pool lines up right now — it stays live. Tell me what to loosen or try different filters.
intent.narrate_nomatch_wait: '{{summary}}' is live in the pool. Nobody lines up right now — it'll keep looking while you're away.
intent.narrate_chat: You're both in. Talk on the right — I'll stay here if you want me for anything.
intent.ask_when: Add roughly when you're free, I'll match you faster:
intent.ask_level: Add roughly what level, I'll match you faster:
intent.edit_city_hint: Matches only pair people in the same city. Leave blank to use your profile city.
intent.pool_empty_hint: No one else in the pool right now
intent.pool_exhausted_label: You've seen everyone in the pool
intent.pool_exhausted_body: Nobody else lines up with this wish right now. Loosen the time or level, or withdraw and try something different.
intent.pool_exhausted_body_with_saved: Nobody new right now. You still have people saved for later — reopen them below, or loosen the wish.
intent.save_hint: Bookmark TA so you can come back later
intent.saved_hint: People you parked from this wish. They stay here until you chat or start over.
intent.narrate_next_match: Here's the next one who wants the same thing.
intent.narrate_pool_exhausted: That was the last person matching this wish. Want to loosen it, or say something else?
intent.narrate_saved: Bookmarked. You'll find TA under Saved in the top bar whenever you want to come back.
intent.narrate_revoked: Withdrawn. What would you rather do?
intent.agent_ask_trait: What kind of person? Just one line.
intent.agent_no_brief: I don't have much on TA yet — check the card on the right.
intent.agent_no_opener: I don't have an opener drafted for this one — best in your own words.
intent.agent_no_reply_hint: I'll skip a suggestion here — your own words will land better.
intent.memory_prefix: Last time you told me you wanted someone {{trait}} — same direction now?
intent.narrate_new_activity: Fresh start. What do you want to do this time?
intent.narrate_new_activity_with_memory: Fresh start. Last time you said you wanted someone {{trait}} — same direction now?
intent.left_placeholder_match: Ask me about TA, or say you want someone different…
intent.left_placeholder_chat: Ask me what to say, or draft a line…
intent.left_placeholder_nomatch: Say what to loosen, or publish a new wish…
intent.left_placeholder_publish: Keep chatting, or confirm on the right…
intent.left_placeholder_published: Keep chatting, or say if you want me to find someone…
intent.ask_city_prompt: One thing first — which city are you in? Matching only shows people close by, so I need this to run your wish.
intent.ask_revoke_prompt: Take this wish back? It'll come off the board and I'll stop looking.
intent.server_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

wish_form.hint: Edit before posting · not saved to profile
wish_form.title: Wish preview
wish_form.description_placeholder: e.g. park walk this weekend, tennis buddy…
wish_form.place_placeholder: e.g. Shanghai Jing'an, Central Park, online
wish_form.place_invalid: We couldn't recognize this location. Enter a real place or type «anywhere».
wish_form.buddy_pref_placeholder: e.g. prefer women, chatty, similar age…
wish_form.notes_placeholder: Anything about the activity — headcount, gear, pace…

intent.handoff_revoke_prompt: You still have a wish hanging. Withdraw it before we switch to introductions?
intent.handoff_confirm_prompt: Sounds like you want to meet people who like this — switch?
intent.ask_trait_fallback: Got it — what kind of person are you hoping for? Pace, vibe, anything.
intent.chat_fallback: Yeah — I feel that too. Say more?
intent.transition_to_matchmaker: Sure — tell me what kind of person you're hoping to meet.

understanding.title: What I've learned about you
understanding.empty: Tell me a bit about who you're looking for, and I'll keep track here.

gate.need_city: Maitri matches people in the same city. Add your city to keep going.

profile.subhead: This is exactly how others see you. Write it in your own words — short, specific, true. The Agents read this, they never invent it.
profile.welcome_sub: Welcome to Maitri. Take a minute to introduce yourself — you can always come back and edit. Skip whenever you like.

section.vitals_hint: Facts the system uses to decide who's near you. Anyone you're introduced to sees these.
section.moments: Pick at least {{n}} and answer in your own words
section.moments_hint: Other people read this to decide whether to say hello. Specific beats clever.
section.favorites_hint: A book, a film, a record, a show, a dish — one line each on why it stayed with you. Start with one book.

visibility.hidden_hint: Hidden — nobody but you sees this.

avatar.hint: A clear headshot works best. JPG or PNG, under 2MB.
avatar.error_type: That doesn't look like an image file.
avatar.error_size: Image is too large — please keep it under 2MB.
avatar.error_read: Couldn't read that file. Try another one.

profile.done_note: Looks good. Anything you change here is reflected immediately in how others see you.
profile.incomplete_note: Whatever you've filled is saved — come back anytime to add more.
profile.autosave_hint: Saves as you type. Stop anytime, pick up later.
profile.preview_hint: This is exactly what someone we introduce will see on the right pane.

me.profile_sub: How you appear to people we introduce
me.invites_empty: No codes yet. Generate one to invite someone you'd vouch for.

delete_account.label: Delete account
delete_account.title: Delete your account?
delete_account.body: This will permanently remove your profile, conversations, saved people, wishes, invite codes and all account data. It cannot be undone.

report.blacklist_body: They won't appear in matches or chats anymore, and this conversation will be deleted.
report.muted: Muted. They won't appear in matches or chats.
report.title: Report this person
report.body: This helps us keep Maitri safe. Reports are stored locally until server moderation is enabled.
report.blocked: Blocked. They will no longer appear in matches or chats.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.who_body: Maitri is a kind, intentional matchmaking experience. This policy explains what data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.collect_identity: Basic account information (name, email, authentication provider).
privacy.collect_profile: Profile details you choose to share, such as city, age, moments, and favorites.
privacy.collect_content: Messages and content you create within the app.
privacy.collect_tech: Device and usage data needed to keep the app running.
privacy.use_body: We use your data only to operate and improve Maitri: matching you with people, showing your profile to others, and keeping conversations safe. We do not sell your data.
privacy.delete_body: You can delete your account at any time from the Me page. Deletion removes your data from our servers.
privacy.contact_body: For privacy questions, reach out to privacy@maitri.app.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.acceptance_body: By using Maitri, you agree to these terms and our Privacy Policy.
terms.eligibility_body: You must be at least 18 years old to use Maitri. Accounts are invite-only during the early release.
terms.conduct_body: Be kind and honest. Harassment, hate speech, spam, or impersonation are not allowed. We may suspend accounts that violate these rules.
terms.content_body: You keep ownership of what you write. You give us permission to use it only to provide the service (matching, messaging, moderation).
terms.termination_body: You may delete your account at any time. We may also suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.
